title: Godot Editor: while idling, it does so much wasteful work that it skips rendering frame and drains the battery.
body: ### Tested versions Several ### System information MacOS, iOS, but the problems are cross-platform. ### Issue description When the editor is idling, it is doing a lot of low-intensity work. On iPads and phones this manifests as a warm device, and a lower battery life. On the desktop, on a Mac hosting Godot with libgodot, it manifests itself as reliably missing a rendering frame when idling, because there is so much work going on there: This shows a one second interval in Godot, where Instruments recorded 21 "hitches" (meaning that there were no updates ready to give to the system compositor) The main culprits are an accumulation of small decisions over the years, and they include: * Extensive network polling from assorted sources (debugger, language server), rather than using notifications ("You have a connection", "A client disconnected") * Bug in LineEdit blinking support * Editor Selection tracking (it really wants to keep that selection in sync at every frame) * AnimationPlayer polling, even when there are no animations. Maybe it just needs company. * Export dialog refreshing its data list, certainly stresses the importance of exporting a game, as no expense will be spared in the pursuit of this noble goal. * Assorted settings are loaded during notification_process, to check if something is active, but that really should be instead a subscription to ProjectSettings changes, and a local variable. The call to EDITOR_GET in these busy loops can consume 1% of the frame processing time. A more pernicious and hidden cost is Node::can_process(), that takes a whooping 16% of time, and I am not sure it can be eliminated easily given the editors' current design. I have noticed that Godot's Editor uses an idiom where every almost every UI element is created, hooked, configured at startup and very little is left to dynamism. It is both time consuming to setup up-front (allocations, layout, font measurements for 99% of things that are never used), but it also bloats the tree. I have been on a quest to eliminate those from the iPad port little by little, to get my startup performance back, but it is generally a slog and a maintenance challenge. Too many repeated transient dialogs that are created over and over (like file pickers) that are just sitting there eating ram, resources and startup time. Generally, I do not think Godot desktop folks care much about this, as their systems are probably more plentiful than an iPad, but the 16% of CPU time on every frame burned on this hurt me right in the feels. I am going to start fixing these for Xogot, and will be sharing my patches as PRs, hoping that they will be useful for the desktop edition as well. ### Steps to reproduce Run Godot under instruments, using the "Hangs", "Hitches" and "Time Profiler" instruments, launch, wait and let it idle. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) No project needed. Anything will do. ### Additional bugs filed after further profiling: * https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/116894 * https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/116893 * https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/116895 ### Not yet filed due to research pending: * SceneMultiplayer::poll -> 2.6% of the cycles (this is an empty project) * JoypadSDL::process_events() -> 4.2% of the cycles (no joypads plugged in) - specifically SDL_WaitEventTimeoutNS taking up 3.3% ### PRs and Updates - LineEdit: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116853 - Poll avoidance: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116866 - SceneTreeDock Polling: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116864 - Hoist another batch of expensive EDITOR_GET from the 3D editor: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116872 - Avoid process_internal in various components when a perfect alternative exists: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117024 - Prevent audio stack from churning when there is nothing to do while idling, and makes it so Godot does not prevent MacOS from sleeping: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117162 - No PR, but just my local change, scene tree expensive work and GLOBAL_GET usage: https://gist.github.com/migueldeicaza/b0607cbddd13a2e00107eb65d85d3f70 (see also: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105910#issuecomment-4415417658)
